prompts.text:
Production asset: one genuinely transparent PNG atlas containing exactly NINE separate matte TOP-HEADER EDGE ATTACHMENTS in a regular THREE-COLUMN THREE-ROW square grid. Equal square cells. Each complete object centered in its own cell with substantial transparent padding all around. No labels, captions, numbers or text. No UI panel itself.
CRITICAL NEW GEOMETRY: every one of the NINE objects is a VERTICAL, TALL, NARROW silhouette. TOTAL visible width INCLUDING THE TAB is approximately TWO THIRDS of visible height (width:height =2:3, like24wide by36tall). Never wider than0.8 times its height. Consistent optical size across all nine. NO broad horizontal objects or flanges. The overall body must feel like a slim vertical cuff, with game-specific organic contour, not a wide icon on a stem. Entire silhouette remains complete and unclipped.
Each piece has a SMALL SHORT INWARD SEATING TAB midway down its LEFT edge. The tab joins the main narrow body directly and adds only a very small fraction to total width; it fits over a vertical header boundary. The opposite side partner will be a horizontal mirror. Do not add a broad rectangular backing, wide handle, horizontal base or shadow plate. Narrowness applies to the whole object including tab.
Camera/style: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN for all nine. Zero perspective, zero isometric angle, zero visible side faces. Minimal textureless MATTE flat filled graphic art, not3D toys. Two solid muted game-specific tones plus at most one tiny cream semantic detail. One broad quiet darker solid shape allowed, no gradients, glossy highlights, reflections, bevels, black outlines, thick contour, cast shadows, grain, texture, stitches, tiny bolts or decorative dashes. Cohesive colors matching quiet charcoal/plum/navy/teal game UI caps. Simple shapes readable at24×36pixels.
True alpha background between all silhouettes and throughout margins. EXACT NINE objects in this row-major order:
Row1:1.MarbleBloom muted plum VERTICAL marble-holder cuff: two small lilac disks stacked vertically in one narrow bracket, tiny cream triangle.2.PocketSiege desaturated steel-teal VERTICAL artillery cuff: overhead barrel pointing straight UP with small flat axle disk in lower half, totalbody narrow, no horizontal cannon side view.3.Poker muted wine VERTICAL chip-holder cuff: one small flat cream-ring chip inside a tall narrow wine grip, two broad darkwine areas, no text.
Row2:4.AirHockey muted ice-blue VERTICAL striker-holder cuff: small flat disk at upper portion of tall narrow ice-blue grip, slate center, no side-face handle.5.BowClub muted olive VERTICAL arrow-nock cuff: short shaft pointing UP with two small cream fletching planes contained inside narrow body.6.Curling desaturated ice-teal VERTICAL stone-holder cuff: small plain oval stone face nested in tall narrow ice-teal grip, one broad slate handle mark, no thickness.
Row3:7.Bowling desaturated amber VERTICAL bowling-pin cuff: upright slim pin with modest cream body and muted coral neck band.8.SwarmGate muted lavender VERTICAL gate-fastener cuff: two broad charcoal/slate linked segments stacked vertically with one tiny teal fastening mark, no broad horizontal gate beam.9.PeekShoot desaturated sage VERTICAL target-holder cuff: small plain targetdisk nested in tall narrow sage grip, cream center and one broad dark partialring.
